contextReview.basis: Direct review: overcast daytime East Asian urban shopping streets with small tiled building walls, bakery and shop windows, canvas awnings, utility poles and stone paving; no rain depicted and reflective paving is not read as rain; humidity not inferred. Mixed adult model casting is independent of the location.

casting.castingPolicy: mixed adult model appearance independent of the East Asian urban location (user 2026-11-03)

approval.evidence: Five editorials passed producer QA and continued under the user's standing workflow authorization (2026-11-03, "앞으로도 승인 없이 진행"); the user did not visually approve them individually. Product images passed producer technical QA and producer visual QA on four backgrounds only.

reconstructionNotice: The baguette and its paper sleeve are scene props, not products; they and the raised arms cover part of the ivory zip jacket and the navy knit, which are conservatively reconstructed. The navy top is a textured knit, not a tee. The brown soft shoulder bag is seen from one side and held up by its strap; its far side and full strap length are inferred. No socks are visible, so none are listed. Brand, fibre composition and retail identity are unknown.

findings: Actual view_image review of all five look overview sheets; all 28 isolated products, complete pairs and straps, no outfit collages or props; clean final composites on four backgrounds.

deck.ko: 아이보리 지퍼 재킷 안의 네이비 짜임.
deck.en: Ivory zip layers reveal navy knit texture.

intro.ko: 가방끈에 걸린 포장지를 풀려고 팔과 어깨를 잠시 모읍니다.
intro.en: He draws an arm and shoulder together to free wrapping paper caught in the bag strap.
intro.de: Arm und Schulter kommen zusammen, um das im Taschengurt verfangene Papier zu lösen.

body.ko: 짧은 아이보리 재킷은 네이비 텍스처 니트 위에 가볍게 열려 있습니다. 검정 바지 아래 흰 스니커가 밝은 끝점을 만들고 갈색 숄더백은 부드러운 곡선을 남깁니다. 플래시는 재킷 봉제선과 손에 모인 끈을 분명하게 보여줍니다.
body.en: The short ivory jacket opens lightly over a textured navy knit. White sneakers finish black trousers with a pale endpoint, and the brown shoulder bag adds a soft curve. Direct flash defines the jacket seams and the strap gathered in his hands.
body.de: Die kurze helle Jacke öffnet sich über strukturiertem Marinestrick. Weiße Sneaker setzen unter schwarzen Hosen einen hellen Abschluss, die braune Schultertasche eine weiche Kurve. Direkter Blitz zeichnet Jackennähte und den Gurt in den Händen klar.

pull.ko: 짧은 밝은 재킷과 긴 어두운 바지.
pull.en: A short pale jacket over long dark trousers.
pull.de: Eine kurze helle Jacke über langen dunklen Hosen.

copy.pullQuoteEn: A short pale jacket over long dark trousers.

tip.ko: 걸음을 멈추고 스트랩을 먼저 풀어 가방이 한쪽 어깨를 당기지 않게 하세요.
tip.en: Stop and free the strap first so the bag does not pull one shoulder.
tip.de: Anhalten und zuerst den Gurt lösen, damit die Tasche nicht an einer Schulter zieht.

description.ko: 포인티드 칼라와 중앙 지퍼, 옆 웰트 포켓의 짧은 재킷입니다.
description.en: Short jacket with pointed collar, central zip and side welt pockets.
description.de: Kurze Jacke mit spitzem Kragen, mittigem Zip und seitlichen Leistentaschen.

howToWear.en: Open slightly to reveal the navy knit texture.
